title: Supported quasi-coherent property is closed under middle terms
statement: theorem supported_qcoh_closedMiddle (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (T : Set X) : (supportedProperty X T).IsTriangulatedClosed₂

source.place: Tag 0A9A, definition of supported subcategory preceding lemma

proof.text: Use isQuasicoherent_kernel and isQuasicoherent_cokernel, transporting along uniqueness isomorphisms for arbitrary kernel forks and cokernel coforks, to install the ObjectProperty kernel and cokernel closure instances. Use isQuasicoherent_of_shortExact for extension closure.

For each degree n apply ObjectProperty.prop_of_exact_of_exact_of_exact to the three successive exact portions of the derived homology sequence H^(n-1)(M) -> H^n(K) -> H^n(L) -> H^n(M) -> H^(n+1)(K). The outer four terms are quasi-coherent by the two hypotheses, giving quasi-coherence of H^n(L).

Compose the module-to-additive-sheaf functor with the additive sheaf stalk functor. This composite is additive and preserves finite limits and colimits, hence maps the central homology exact sequence to an exact sequence of additive groups. The two outer groups are zero by the stalk hypotheses at x outside T. ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero makes the middle group zero, and AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero gives its subsingleton carrier. Apply le_isoClosure to the resulting supported middle object.
